title: kate-core: keep the applied transactions for the shell
summary: Every transaction that execute applies, including undo and redo, is pushed to an outbox as a DocumentChange with the document, the revisions, the transaction, and a rope snapshot of the text before it. drain_changes hands them to the shell, which builds didChange events from them.

lane.reason: A Cursor cloud agent codes this packet. workspace.rs is a 3,500-line file and the change touches its command dispatch. The Linux VM builds and tests kate-core. The owner Mac stays free for the window.

definitions.definition: pub use workspace::{Axis, CloseResult, DocumentChange, EditorConfig, OpenError, SplitTree, Workspace};

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add changes: Vec<DocumentChange> to Workspace and push in apply_change before the buffer apply, with before_text from buffer.snapshot(), and after the apply fill after. Push the same shape from undo_cmd and redo_cmd with the transaction they apply. A transaction that fails to apply pushes nothing. drain_changes returns std::mem::take(&mut self.changes). Update the pub use line in lib.rs. The test drain_changes_returns_each_transaction_once types a, asserts one change with before revision 0, after revision 1, before_text empty, and a transaction with one insert; a second drain is empty; after Undo the drain has one change whose before_text is a. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::drain_changes_returns_each_transaction_once
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because drain_changes does not exist. After the change each applied transaction is handed out once with its pre-state text.
